task.title: Guidance command scanner: close the gaps
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M84). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

The test that scans the docs for Workbook commands has gaps. Any `--help` or `-h` in an invocation passes before the command is resolved. Short options are never checked. `docs/reference.md` and the README get only the subcommand check. A command is checked within one paragraph only.

## Wanted

Allow `--help` only after the command path resolves, check short options, and give the reference and the README the full check.

## Done when

- A made-up command followed by `--help` fails the test.
- An unknown short option fails the test.
